title: Share Unity Catalog agent skills with OpenSharing and Databricks Marketplace (Beta)
body: Providers can add Unity Catalog agent skills to OpenSharing shares and Databricks Marketplace listings. Databricks-to-Databricks recipients get read-only access to each shared skill in the catalog they create from the share, and changes that the provider makes reach recipients asynchronously. See [Add agent skills to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#skills) and [Create a Marketplace listing](/aws/en/marketplace/create-listing).
